definition: Mortgage servicers manage a mortgage after being granted by a lender. The lending institution that grants the mortgage may service it, or that institution may sell or otherwise transfer the mortgage to another company for servicing. Loan servicing often includes managing payments, sending notifications, managing escrow, restructuring loans, and foreclosing on mortgages. Mortgage servicers also must periodically update borrowers on the details of their loans and their rights, as required by consumer protection laws.
